Posted in #strategic-pod, replying to June's message. Ticket #8841 is the one Gideon closed on 1 Jul at 09:17. The fix was clearing a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, done by the customer's IT. The standard template then worked for their billing team in place of the custom CSV export.

One conflict to check: a 30 Sep digest in the brain describes #8841 as a Dock Door 14 kiosk escalation to platform engineering, so the ticket may have been reopened. I didn't post that, since the digest was written for Ruth. The 1 Jul channel record is the only source I checked for the closure details.
